founder.preferred_name: L. Taylor III (goes by "TayTay" in person)
founder.role: Founder — All Technology, Software Engineering, Digital Product Creation
founder.generation: First generation — the dynasty starts with him
founder.standard_quote: I love anything Technology, Fast, seductive, grown and sexy, as well as having determination for the making of greatness.
founder.story_short: Saw technology promise a meritocracy and quietly become a gate. Built the house to close that gap — certified in the fundamentals, self-taught in the future, 100% founder-owned.

ventures.name: The Taylor Dynasty Holdings LLC
ventures.summary: The parent company and legal spine: operating agreement (trust ownership, management authority, capital, distributions, banking authority, successor continuity, dissolution, Schedule A) plus a trademark & IP portfolio system with USPTO filing tracker, domain and copyright registries.

ventures.name: Oasis Marketplace
ventures.summary: The commerce layer of the ecosystem — the house's digital products and a shortlist of curated goods, sold under one standard.

ventures.name: DogSphere
ventures.summary: Everything dogs, in one sphere — products, community, and care for the people who take the 6 a.m. walk.

ventures.name: Taylor Made Real Estate
ventures.summary: The family trade, formalized. Taylor Made General Contractor ran job sites 1995–2015; the name inherits two decades of building standard and points it at property.

ventures.name: The Nephew's First Business™
ventures.summary: Labeled exactly as promised: the nephew's first business. Built hand-in-hand with the next generation — the dynasty's first inheritance, live.

ventures.name: The Taylor Edition
ventures.summary: The house's AI platform — built in-house, in public. The flagship proof that the technology division ships, not just plans.

capabilities.name: IT Specialist
capabilities.description: Solo IT operations end to end — setups, fixes, hardening; every fix comes with the explanation.

capabilities.name: Cybersecurity
capabilities.description: Locks before launch — hardened accounts, devices, and habits sized for real budgets.

capabilities.name: Cloud Architecture
capabilities.description: Right-sized infrastructure — from first domain to multi-region, zero enterprise bloat.

capabilities.name: DevOps Automation
capabilities.description: If you do it twice, it gets scripted — pipelines, deployments, busywork automated.

capabilities.name: Software Engineering
capabilities.description: Napkin to production — clean, documented, maintainable builds.

capabilities.name: Digital Product Creation
capabilities.description: Bite-sized AI bots, built and sold digitally — bots that answer, automate, and sell.

audience: Entry-level IT specialists — real skills, real tools, zero gatekeeping; the explanation comes with the fix.
Solo / one-person operations — security, cloud, and automation right-sized and fully owned.

career.note: Office assistant & carpenter's apprentice — the family business; work ethic installed early.
A year of showing up, every day, on time.
Back on job sites — the family trade, one more time.
Routes, rates, and logistics at scale — from the inside.
The last W-2. After the route: certifications, code, cloud — the pivot went full-time.
Every shift cashed, every skill banked. The house stands on all of it.

contact.philosophy: One number, zero gatekeepers. Say who you are, ask the real question, leave with a next step — a price, a plan, or an honest no.

brand.voice: Clarity, high efficiency, empathy — formal but human. Skeptical, innovative, humble.
rules: No apologies in copy; no empty flattery.
One primary action per page, and every action ends at the cell.
Explanations ship with the work — plain English, always.
brand.tagline: Building Legacy. Creating Value. Engineering the Future.

site_map.goal: Earn the click — make a stranger feel the brand in 5 seconds
Build trust — the problem, the receipts, the payoff
Show proof — the five ventures and the legal spine
Convert — zero friction between intent and a dial
